historical_scope: Isolated current-Tiger controls bench with one disclosed initial source-triangle ignition, shared by the correct-aim and wrong-aim pair. This is not a historical incident or calibrated combustion experiment.
input_audit: The identical disclosed setup ray seeds one source contact after warmup. Gaze-only helpers turn the ordinary loader head toward the visible extinguisher or fire. The first short ordinary LMB press picks up the mounted tool; release ends the pickup press; a separate fresh LMB press drives the physical nozzle. No F shortcut, forced equipped state, direct foam deposit, suppression, invulnerability or outcome is used. Enemy absence isolates the controls experiment; live ammunition remains and any cookoff is ordinary.
limitations: The rebuilt release was evaluated and recorded. Player-view frames and actual delayed CookOff delivery were verified; subjective headphone or speaker audition remains separate. Aimed surface extinction does not prevent the already ignited cartridge from cooking off, so survival remains a failed acceptance.
Surface fire/exposure remain authored bounded models; this pair measures control and coating causality, not physical foam chemistry or measured heat transfer.
visual_acceptance: The wall-mounted extinguisher visibly moves into the hands after the first LMB press.
The first pickup press does not discharge foam. Release then fresh LMB produces a nozzle-led jet.
After trigger release airborne grains settle or expire while matte coating remains on the actual contacted surfaces.
The fixed input sweep visibly covers the seeded surface; remaining fire and ammunition exposure must fall through ordinary coating response. Any failed receipt remains a failure.
